title: OotleAccord
summary: Community milestone escrow with capped native-TARI funding, a percentage quorum and a mandatory reviewer. Contribution amounts, reviewer identities and votes are public; fixed-destination payouts and refunds use private outputs with encrypted recovery memos. The current community accord displays a completed 10 tTARI payout and three approvals; four designated reviewers share a test operator. Create exports terms rather than deploying another escrow. October 31 review inspected the creator’s README, original submission and public accord/review screens; no wallet connection or transaction was performed. The app trusts its pinned indexer; the creator distinguishes installed-extension validation from SDK tests.
cardSummary: Fund community milestones with public contributions and reviewer approvals, then release private payouts to a fixed recipient.
creator: SealClubber

recording.credit: App demo — read-only public completed accord and review screen; no funding, approval or payout submitted.
